The chest X-ray shows bilateral interstitial infiltrates suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis. To determine the specific cause, how much shortness of breath do you experience during daily activities, and do you notice any dry cough or history of asbestos exposure?

REQUEST TEST: Pulmonary_Function_Tests

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Reduced FVC and FEV1 with a normal FEV1/FVC ratio, indicating a restrictive pattern.

speaker: Doctor

REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Panel

speaker: Doctor

Given the normal autoimmune panel, do you have a history of smoking, and have you experienced any skin changes like "salt and pepper" pigmentation or telangiectasias on your face or hands?

REQUEST TEST: Anti_Centromere_Antibody

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF). The combination of restrictive lung disease, bilateral interstitial infiltrates on X-ray, and negative autoimmune panels points to this diagnosis. Do you have any family history of lung disease?
